text: Our IELTS course is designed to help students achieve their learning goals by mastering English for Academic Purposes. The course covers test-taking strategies specific to the IELTS test, as well as general abilities such as academic vocabulary, grammar, research, critical thinking, and writing that are required when studying at an English-medium institution. The qualification has a core unit of competency requirements that cover common skills for the construction industry, as well as the specialist field of work, solid plastering. Solid plasterers apply plaster, cement and other mixtures to walls to create smooth or decorative finishes to interior walls and to render to exterior walls.

Level Up Education & Training Academy recognises that learners may already possess skills, knowledge, or qualifications relevant to the CPC31020 Certificate III in Solid Plastering. The Academy ensures fair and transparent processes for Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) and Credit Transfer (CT) in accordance with the 2025 Standards for RTOs (Outcome Standards 1.6 and 1.7), and its Credit Transfer Policy & Procedure and Fees and Refund Policy & Procedure.

Learners are encouraged to apply for RPL prior to or immediately after formal enrolment but prior to the facilitated delivery of units to ensure that they do not miss any training opportunities offered should they be unsuccessful in the RPL process. Process overview is following:
Applicants are informed of RPL options during pre-enrolment.
An RPL Application Form and supporting evidence (e.g., work samples, portfolios, employment records) are submitted.
A qualified assessor evaluates the evidence against the unit requirements published on
Where full competency is not demonstrated, gap training may be recommended.
RPL outcomes are recorded and communicated to the applicant in writing.
All RPL assessments are conducted under the Principles of Assessment and Rules of Evidence, ensuring validity, reliability, fairness, and authenticity.
Credit Transfer is available for equivalent or identical units of competency previously completed through another Nationally Recognised Training provider.
Applicants provide verified Statements of Attainment or Transcripts.
The Academy verifies authenticity through the USI Registry or the issuing RTO.
Verified equivalent units are recorded as Credit Transfer and reflected in the student’s training plan.

Where Credit Transfer affects course duration, an updated Confirmation of Enrolment (CoE) is issued in accordance with CRICOS requirements. International students must continue to meet the minimum 20 scheduled contact hours per week as required under the ESOS Act 2000 and National Code 2018.

Fees and processing timeframes for RPL and Credit Transfer applications are detailed in the Credit Transfer Policy & Procedure and Fees and Refund Policy & Procedure. These policies specify applicable fees, expected processing periods, and any adjustments to enrolment or course duration.

Learners who wish to appeal an RPL or Credit Transfer decision may do so in accordance with the Academy’s Complaints and Appeals Policy and Procedure, which ensures transparency, procedural fairness, and timely resolution.

It includes core competencies that cover essential skills for the construction industry, along with specialised training in wall and floor tiling. Tilers work with materials such as ceramic, glass, slate, marble, and clay. They cut these materials and install tiles on walls and floors, both indoors and outdoors. Additionally, tilers may incorporate decorative elements into their work.
State and territory jurisdictions may have different licensing and regulatory requirements, so it's essential to consult the relevant authorities to confirm them.
This qualification supports an Australian apprenticeship pathway.

Completion of the general construction induction training program outlined in the Safe Work Australia model Code of Practice: Construction Work is required for anyone in construction. Achieving CPC31320 Prepare to Work Safely in the Construction Industry fulfils this requirement.

Our nationally accredited CPC50220 Diploma of Building and Construction (Building) empowers you to elevate your career in the dynamic world of building and construction. Graduates will find themselves adept at selecting contractors, overseeing work quality, and ensuring compliance with project requirements.
